about: Telo Genomics Corp., a molecular diagnostics company, develops and commercializes predictive technological products to personalize treatment plans for patients with specific conditions in Canada. The company offers TeloView, a proprietary diagnostic platform that analyses the three-dimensional telomere and nuclear architecture to assess genomic instability, a fundamental driver of cancer progression. It also develops TeloView SMM, a laboratory developed test prognostic solution for smoldering multiple myeloma patients; TeloView NDMM, a test for newly diagnosed multiple myeloma patients; TeloMRD-D to monitor minimal residual disease (MRD) in multiple myeloma patients; and TeloViewNewGeneration-MRD, an assay combining its enumeration MRD with the proprietary TeloView profiling. In addition, the company develops tests for prostate cancer and Alzheimer's disease. It has a collaboration agreement with the Mayo Clinic for product development activities. Telo Genomics Corp. is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
